articles.title: Eli Lilly Expands Legal Crackdown on Unauthorized Compounded Weight-Loss Drugs
articles.summary: Eli Lilly has filed additional lawsuits against medical spas and compounding pharmacies selling unapproved versions of its GLP-1 medications like tirzepatide. For self-funded employers and PBMs managing surging obesity drug costs, this crackdown impacts employee access to lower-cost alternatives amid ongoing supply and coverage pressures.
articles.source_line: Source: Bloomberg Law News; Thu, 08 Oct 2026
